_comment: BEVERLY — the bot for briankeegan's Panel Attack server. GENERATED from a GameCreator training run, do not hand-tune. Weights are for bot/PanelEval.lua and are SHARES: every feature is divided by its own bound before weighting, so a weight is that feature's share of the decision. The divisors live in PanelEval.FEATURES and must match the JavaScript registry they were found under.
_switches: A WEIGHT SET IS ONLY A BOT WHEN PAIRED WITH THE SWITCHES IT WAS FOUND UNDER. depth 2 (a candidate is worth the best of stopping there or any single reply), beam 0 (every candidate expanded), rise on (each candidate scored one settle row later plus the rows that land while the cursor walks), reaction 12, density off.
_record: 11W-0L-1D of 12 against s131-s131.0919-041315.g06000; 7000 updates across 4 islands.
